        raise ValueError("required_failure_items must be list of strings")
    if not isinstance(unresolved_without, list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in unresolved_without):
        raise ValueError("unresolved_without must be list of strings")
    # required_failure_items must be subset of items
    if not set(required).issubset(set(items)):
        raise ValueError("required_failure_items not subset of items")
    if not set(unresolved_without).issubset(set(items)):
        raise ValueError("unresolved_without not subset of items")

    # define oracle using payload data
    def test(subset):

        # According to requirement: "Require the initial configuration to produce FAIL."

    test_count = 1  # we have already tested full set
    # ddmin algorithm
    n = 2  # initial granularity
    while len(config) > 1:
        # partition config into n parts (approximately equal)
        parts = []
        part_size = (len(config) + n - 1) // n  # ceiling division

    # After loop, config is minimal failure
